title: One Additional Run Step
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$, and fix a Boolean input string $x$. For every choice word $w$ and every $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the configuration reached from $c$ by running $M$ on the prefix of $w$ of length $j+1$ is either the configuration reached by running $M$ on the prefix of length $j$, or is obtained by applying a single action to that latter configuration.
